Our story

Knostic is a fast-paced, innovative startup at the cutting edge of two of tech's hottest fields: AI and cybersecurity. We empower organizations to safely unlock the potential of LLMs, doing good while building groundbreaking technology.

See our open positions

Build the Future of AI Security

At Knostic, we are innovating advanced access controls for LLMs, enabling businesses to confidently adopt AI tools like Copilot and Glean while preventing critical data leaks. We’re at the forefront of AI and cybersecurity, and growing fast after recent significant investments.

Highly skilled

We are a team of highly skilled and experienced professionals who are passionate about our work. We are constantly learning and growing, and we are always looking for new and innovative ways to solve problems.

Collaborative culture

We support your growth through hands-on experience with the latest AI technology. Here at Knostic, you'll find a collaborative culture where creativity drives innovation. Your work will directly impact how companies safely use AI across the globe.

AI challenge

Knostic tackles a critical AI challenge: stopping large language models from sharing sensitive data. We build cutting-edge security tools that protect companies using generative AI. Join our team to shape the future of AI security.

Rapid Growth

Having secured $19 million in investment and as a finalist in the RSA 2025 Innovation Sandbox, we're on a successful streak and rapidly expanding! Join us in tackling the complex and purposeful challenge of protecting AI systems from emerging threats—it’s an exciting time to be at Knostic!
